sample.name: SoFA Market
facts: Food hall in the SoFA District with locally-owned eateries, cafes and small vendors.
Vendors include Vietnoms, Pizza Way, Umi Handroll Bar and Habana Cuba.
Address: 387 South 1st Street, San Jose

sample.name: Sweet Maple
facts: Serves Millionaire's Bacon, a trademarked brunch dish.
Brought its brunch menu to downtown Palo Alto in 2022.
Serves American food

sample.name: Alexander's Steakhouse
facts: Has a glass-enclosed dry-aging room and serves Japanese Wagyu and dry-aged domestic steaks.
Located in the Main Street Cupertino center.
Listed in the MICHELIN Guide California.

sample.name: Naschmarkt
facts: Named after the largest open-air produce market in Vienna.
Focuses on Austrian and German cuisine.
The Palo Alto location opened on May 17, 2022.

sample.name: Bijan Bakery and Café
facts: Bijan Abachizadeh and his family have made pastries, cakes and croissants here since 1986.
Uses mostly imported European ingredients and no preservatives or trans fats.
Serves European food

sample.name: Alice's Restaurant
facts: Has been a restaurant since the 1950s and was named for owner Alice Taylor and the Arlo Guthrie song.
Family owned and operated since the 1970s at the Four Corners intersection on Skyline Boulevard.
Address: 17299 Skyline Blvd

sample.name: Le Petit Bistro
facts: Open since 1989, owned and run by chef Jean-Michel Peuvrelle.
Peuvrelle was born in Pas-de-Calais, France, the son of a charcutier.
Serves French food

sample.name: Barbayani Greek Taverna
facts: Named for Barba Yani, a black-bearded innkeeper who welcomed travelers.
Opened September 30, 2023 by chef-owner Allen Isik and co-owner Dino Tekdemir.
Serves Greek food

sample.name: Camper
facts: Serves Californian and contemporary cuisine in a window-lined corner space.
Listed in the MICHELIN Guide for California.
Serves American food

sample.name: Ettan
facts: Chef Srijith Gopinathan cooks upscale Indian food with Californian ingredients.
Listed in the MICHELIN Guide California.
Serves Indian food

sample.name: Cafe Venetia
facts: Opened to bring the northern Italian coffee tradition to Palo Alto.
Sells Gardini chocolates.
Sells Italian roasted coffee beans.

sample.name: Izzy's Brooklyn Bagels
facts: Established in 1996.
Kosher, supervised by the Vaad Hakashrus of Northern California.
Serves bagels

sample.name: Dittmer's Gourmet Meats & Wurst-Haus
facts: Founder Dittmer Bubert began at 14 in his family's delicatessen in Hamburg, Germany.
Opened in Mountain View in 1978 and reopened in Los Altos after a 2011 fire.
Run today by his daughter Petra Silva.

sample.name: Sakoon
facts: The name is the Indian word for peace.
The dining room has hand-carved wooden Buddha panels and a waterfall into a pool of lotus petals.
Serves Indian food

sample.name: Cafe Baklava
facts: Mediterranean restaurant serving Mountain View since 2005.
Its chefs use traditional cooking techniques passed down through generations.
Serves Mediterranean food

sample.name: Vina Enoteca
facts: Run by Rocco Scordella, a native of Italy.
Pastas, pizzas and bread are made in-house.
Most greens and vegetables come from the Stanford Education Farm.

sample.name: Sara's Kitchen
facts: Founded on April 27, 1992 by Sara and Manny Manion as a burger and cheesesteak shop.
Diner serving breakfast fare, pancakes, waffles and cheesesteak variations.
Serves diner

sample.name: Little Blue Door
facts: Opened April 6, 2022 by chef Srijith Gopinathan and Ayesha Thapar of Ettan.
Serves Indian street food and family recipes with seasonal California ingredients.
Serves Indian food

sample.name: Amber India
facts: Founded by Vijay Bist; after 20 years in Mountain View it moved across El Camino Real to Los Altos.
The Los Altos restaurant is in a hacienda-style building with a patio and banquet room.
Serves Indian food

sample.name: Flea Street Cafe
facts: Has served diners since 1980 in a house with small rooms.
Builds a seasonal farm-to-table menu around produce from nearby farms and the coast.
Listed in the MICHELIN Guide California.

sample.name: Fuki Sushi
facts: Established in 1978 as the first Japanese restaurant in Palo Alto.
Family owned, with chefs trained and licensed in Japan.
Serves Japanese food

sample.name: Palo Alto Sol
facts: Owners Hector and Helena Sol bring cooking from their hometown of Puebla.
It is a daughter restaurant of La Fiesta in Mountain View.
Serves Mexican food

sample.name: Chef Chu's
facts: Silicon Valley figures including Steve Jobs, Gordon Moore and Mark Zuckerberg have eaten at Chef Chu's.
Serves Chinese food

sample.name: Los Altos Grill
facts: Part of the Hillstone Restaurant Group.
Specialties include Carolina-style beef ribs and rotisserie chicken.
Serves American food

sample.name: Scott’s Seafood
facts: Serves oysters, crab cakes, grilled fish and cioppino with a full bar.
Offers indoor and outdoor patio seating plus private dining spaces.
Serves seafood
